t2.thesis: MARA is a high-volatility, beaten-down bitcoin and AI-power name with a roughly 15% implied move, and no clear edge on direction, so the reaction is close to a coin flip around the base rate.
reasons: Base rate of about 54% for AMC buy-everything; the crypto_proxy cluster sample is too small to use.
Stock down 63% over 12 months and 37% over 1 month, with 33% short interest. This gives rebound/squeeze potential but also negative momentum and weak fundamentals (revenue -27%, huge losses).
Sector sentiment is fragile: Texas data-center policy risk, Bernstein target cuts, and a 14% single-day drop on Nov 5 despite FERC approval, which is already priced in.
Past reactions were weak: last-4 win rate 25%, last surprise -30%, and the entry open on Monday already reflects the weekend's bitcoin move.
Implied move of 15% is large, so outcome is dominated by bitcoin and AI-lease news (a lease signing would be a large upside catalyst; management targets at least one by year-end).
t2.deciding_variable: Whether management announces or credibly advances an AI/HPC lease (Starwood partnership) and gives Long Ridge/Texas clarity, versus another weak mining-economics print.
